source.test: installRequiredDependencies(of:into:depth:) depth guard vs true cycle detection

input.scenario: A requires B (depth 0->1), B requires A (depth 1->2), A requires B again (depth 2->3, guard fires)

expected.reason: The resolver has no `Set<projectId>` of already-visited projects in this recursion chain -- it genuinely cannot tell 'this is a cycle' from 'this dependency tree happens to be 3 levels deep'. A real A<->B cycle only stops because depth eventually hits 3, coincidentally, not because either project ID is recognized as already being resolved in this call stack. A length-4 legitimate (non-cyclic) dependency chain would be truncated at exactly the same depth.
